# Real papers used as test fixtures

Three research papers published as Word files on Zenodo under the Creative
Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, which permits redistribution with credit.
They are used unchanged, to test Prarup on what real authors actually write.

| File | Paper | Authors | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `yolo_football.docx` | YOLO-Based Object Detection and Player Tracking for Automated Football Match Analysis | Dipto Roy | [Zenodo 16929566](https://zenodo.org/records/16929566) | CC BY 4.0 |
| `uav_imagery.docx` | Machine Learning for UAV and Ground-Captured Imagery: Toward Standard Practices | Kayeleigh Sharp, Brooklyn Christofis, Upesh Nepal, Hossein Eslamiat, Carlos Osores Mendives | [Zenodo 11105119](https://zenodo.org/records/11105119) | CC BY 4.0 |
| `svm_diabetes.docx` | Support vector machine classification learning algorithm for diabetes prediction | Renas Rajab Asaad | [Zenodo 6975670](https://zenodo.org/records/6975670) | CC BY 4.0 |

What each one exercises:

- **yolo_football**: an "Author(s):" label line, "Email:" line, figures with no
  captions, a table nested inside a table cell, a six-column text table
- **uav_imagery**: a logo above the title, superscript-numbered affiliations,
  captions as paragraphs and block quotes, sub-images captioned together
  ("Figures 4 a and b"), captions whose image is missing
- **svm_diabetes**: no real headings (sections are bold paragraphs), the
  abstract and keywords inside a layout table spelt "A B S T R A C T", table
  captions both before and after their tables, equations as inline maths with
  "(2)", a right-to-left mark copied from elsewhere
